suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as disease progression complication. Require documented periodontitis/periodontal disease and separately documented tooth loss attributable to periodontal attachment/bone loss. Do not infer cause of tooth loss when caries, trauma, extraction for other reasons, or other etiologies predominate. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Periodontal Disease and Loss of Occlusal Surface / Loss of Teeth
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes

Resolution of the publication guard: Require documented periodontitis/periodontal disease and separately documented tooth loss attributable to periodontal attachment/bone loss. Do not infer cause of tooth loss when caries, trauma, extraction for other reasons, or other etiologies predominate.
